script_parts.opening: Namaskar, Aksar Wire Products ji — main IndiaMART se bol raha hoon. Dekh raha hoon ki aapka account kaafi purana hai, almost 25 saal se aap hamare saath hain, lekin pichle mahine aapki BL velocity ek dum -100% ho gayi — matlab buyers se bilkul contact band ho gaya. Yeh achanak hua, isliye seedha aapse baat karna zaroori laga.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai, 8 mahine pehle tak aapka account kaafi active tha, phir ek dum se engagement drop hua — kya koi specific wajah rahi? Kya team mein koi change hua, ya platform pe kuch issue aaya jo replies ya catalog update rok raha tha?
script_parts.value_demo: Ek concrete cheez share karta hoon — aapka CQS score abhi 48 hai, aur jo sellers 60 se upar hote hain unhe buyers ki search mein kaafi zyada visibility milti hai. Upar se aapki reply rate sirf 13.3% hai aur last 30 din mein sirf 6 active days recorded hain — iska seedha matlab hai ki jo bhi buyers aapke products dekh rahe hain, unhe response nahi mil raha aur woh competitor ke paas ja rahe hain.
script_parts.action: Abhi is call pe hum ek kaam karte hain — main aapke saath aapki top 2-3 product listings open karta hoon aur dekhte hain kahan CQS score down hai: images hain ya nahi, specifications complete hain ya nahi. Bas 10 minute mein hum ek quick fix identify kar sakte hain jo visibility turant improve kare.
script_parts.close: Bhai, main aapko ek simple checklist WhatsApp karta hoon — sirf 3 changes jo aap ya aapki team is hafte kar sake. Koi pressure nahi, bas ek baar try karke dekh lete hain ki buyers ka response wapas aata hai ya nahi — theek hai?

script_parts_en.opening: Hello, Aksar Wire Products ji — I'm calling from IndiaMART. I can see your account is nearly 25 years old with us, but last month your BL velocity dropped to -100% — meaning buyer connections completely stopped. This was a sudden cliff, which is why I wanted to reach out directly.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: Bhai, your account was quite active up until about 8 months ago and then engagement dropped sharply — was there a specific reason? Was there a team change, or did something on the platform make it difficult to reply or update the catalog?
script_parts_en.value_demo: Here's a concrete data point — your CQS score is currently 48, and sellers above 60 get significantly higher visibility in buyer searches. On top of that, your reply rate is only 13.3% and you've had just 6 active days in the last 30 days — which means buyers who do find your products are not getting responses and are moving to competitors.
script_parts_en.action: Let's do one thing right now on this call — I'll pull up your top 2-3 product listings with you and check exactly where the CQS score is falling: are images missing, are specifications incomplete? In just 10 minutes we can identify a quick fix that can immediately improve your buyer visibility.
script_parts_en.close: Bhai, I'll WhatsApp you a simple checklist — just 3 changes that you or your team can make this week. No pressure at all, let's just try it once and see if buyer responses start coming back — does that work for you?

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
